Frequently asked questions

Do you support small offices?

Yes. We support offices of every size, from a few users to multi-floor sites.

Can you take over our existing IT?

Yes. We start with a review of what you have, then fix, document and maintain it.

Do you offer maintenance contracts?

Yes. Our AMC covers preventive maintenance and on-site support for your IT.
